run_ml_neb_validation: run a validation of the ML NEB model on a set of NEB calculations using a pretrained checkpoint
run_validation_with_dft_sp: run ML NEB validation with optional DFT single point calculations on transition states via vasp
get_results_ml: get the percent success and convergence for ML-only NEB calculations from a results dataframe
get_results_sp: get the percent success and convergence for NEB calculations including DFT single points on transition states
parse_neb_info: parse ML NEB results to extract barrier height, reaction energy, convergence, and transition state index
